html:
For building muscle or "boosting growth hormone": no peptide is approved for that. Here is what the sold ones actually are.

No peptide is FDA approved for building muscle. Tesamorelin is approved for one specific use in people with HIV; growth hormone peptides sold for muscle are not approved.

  • Tesamorelin (Egrifta)FDA approvedA prescription shot approved only for belly fat in people with HIV.

    A daily shot approved only to reduce belly fat in people with HIV. Sold off-label by clinics for "growth hormone".

    FDA approved for HIV-related belly fat only.

    Prescription.

    No listings yet
  • SermorelinNo FDA-approved product on the marketA growth-hormone-releasing shot made by compounding pharmacies; no approved product is on the market.

    A growth-hormone-releasing shot from compounding pharmacies; the approved brand was taken off the market years ago.

    No FDA-approved product on the market.

    Prescription through clinics.

    No listings yet
  • CJC-1295 / ipamorelinNot approvedGrowth-hormone-releasing peptides in research-use vials, with no large human trials.

    Growth-hormone-releasing peptides sold by research-use shops and some clinics. No approved product, no large human trials.

    Not approved for any use.

    Research-use shops, with our checks.
